themes.title: Documentation gaps
themes.summary: Two tests both show missing supporting information for claims.
themes.root_cause_hypothesis: This may reflect a gap in the receipt-attachment step for these claim types.

themes.title: Approval and daily-spend weaknesses
themes.summary: Approval and daily-spend controls both show exceptions in the same population.
themes.root_cause_hypothesis: This may reflect insufficient review before reimbursement.

themes.title: Unlinked travel
themes.summary: Pre-approved travel and its expense claims do not always reconcile.
themes.root_cause_hypothesis: This may reflect incomplete integration between travel and expense systems.

themes.title: Supplier and per-head spend exceptions
themes.summary: Preferred-supplier and per-head spend limits both show exceptions.
themes.root_cause_hypothesis: This may reflect inconsistent enforcement of spend policy at booking time.
